S.FORM: alang Qrahu ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 63 buwan, 135 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 72% kyan ku 97 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 28% kyan ku 38 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 60%, Amis 4%, Paywan 2%, Bunun 1%, Cou 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 3%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ru kyokay. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Qrahu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Qrahu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Qrahu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Qrahu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Qrahu hya' ga Ngurus. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ qraħu ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * pajwan * βunun * [ʦ|ʨ]ou * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na qraħu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na qraħu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na qraħu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na qraħu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na qraħu ħjaʔ ɣa ŋuru[s|ɕ] reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
